# MG+ | Moderna galerija / Museum of Modern Art

![](/media/179975c027/_EES4632-750x260.jpg)

**Dear visitors!**

Two exhibitions of works from the Moderna galerija collection – [20th Century. Continuities and Ruptures](https://www.mg-lj.si/en/exhibitions/289/mg-20th-century-continuities-and-ruptures/) and [Points in Time](https://www.mg-lj.si/en/exhibitions/1914/points-in-time-1889%E2%80%931991/) – are on view. More about current exhibitions on the [program of all permanent and temporary exhibitions](https://www.mg-lj.si/en/exhibitions/).

You can also visit the [MG Bookstore](https://www.mg-lj.si/en/visit/882/mg-bookstore/) and the [Café Moderna](https://www.mg-lj.si/en/visit/1263/moderna-coffee-shop/).

**OPEN:**

**Tuesday — Sunday 10 a.m. — 6 p.m.**

**Thursday 10 a.m. — 8 p.m. (July and August)**

 

24\. 12. and 31. 12. 10 a.m. — 15. p.m.

Last entrance: half an hour before the Gallery closes.  

**CLOSED: on Mondays and 1 January, 1 May, 1 November, 25 December**

[MG+ Venue](/en/visit/780/mg-acess/)

**ADMISSION FEE**

Adults: € 7.00

Students, seniors and people over 65: € 3.50

Groups (adults)*: € 5.00

Groups (students, seniors)*: € 3.00

Families (up to 2 adults + children up to 18): € 14.00

\* Minimum group size ten people

Combined ticket adult MG+MSUM: € 10.50

Combined ticket family MG+MSUM: € 21.00

Tickets are sold up to half an hour before the gallery closes**.**

**Free admission** | every first Sunday of the month, preschool children, the unemployed, holders of the EU Disability Card and their escorts, holders of [CIMAM](http://cimam.org/), [ICOM](http://www.icom-slovenia.si/), Community of Museums of Slovenia ([SMS](http://www.sms-muzeji.si/)), Slovenian Museum Society ([SMD](http://www.smd-drustvo.si/)), Slovenian Art and History Society ([SUZD](http://www.suzd.si/)), [Ljubljana Card](https://www.visitljubljana.com/en/visitors/sights-and-activities/ljubljana-card/);

*Free admission applies to all exhibitions organized by the Museum of Modern Art and the Museum of Contemporary Art Metelkova.*

**GUIDED TOURS**

Groups of up to 10 people: € 20. Groups of more than 10 people: € 1 per person.

Guided tours are possible by prior arrangement **at least five working days before** the desired date.

E: <izobrazevanje@mg-lj.si>

**GETTING TO MODERNA GALERIJA / MUSEUM OF MODERN ART | ACCESS**

Cankarjeva 15, 1000 Ljubljana, Slovenia

[MG+ Venue](/en/visit/780/mg-acess/)

**By bus** | Buses stopping in the vicinity of Moderna galerija (MG+).

Routes 01, 02, 03, 03B, 03G, 06, 06B, 09, 11, 11B, 14, 14B, 18, 19B, 19I, 27 – get off at the [Konzorcij](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Konzorcij,+Slovenija/Moderna+galerija+Ljubljana+-+knji%C5%BEnica,+Slovenija/@46.0518756,14.4989111,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d617aa2ece1:0x586c8a255d0b02f9!2m2!1d14.503034!2d46.051138!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d607a56d5a9:0x3ab5ddc92ba47796!2m2!1d14.498766!2d46.052969!3e2) or [Pošta](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Po%C5%A1ta,+Slovenija/Moderna+galerija+Ljubljana+-+knji%C5%BEnica,+Slovenija/@46.0520215,14.4989111,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d619ad5b61b:0x51167a14d3f3aaec!2m2!1d14.503402!2d46.052112!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d607a56d5a9:0x3ab5ddc92ba47796!2m2!1d14.498766!2d46.052969!3e2) stops.

Routes 01, 03, 03B, 05, 07, 07L, 08, 25 – get off at the [Lev](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Hotel+Lev,+Slovenija/Moderna+galerija+Ljubljana+-+knji%C5%BEnica,+Slovenija/@46.054419,14.4981487,17z/data=!4m19!4m18!1m10!1m1!1s0x4765329fa1b20f85:0x16769fb44ff0e791!2m2!1d14.501824!2d46.056529!3m4!1m2!1d14.5017656!2d46.054324!3s0x4765329fd250a4a1:0xd12b63813183ca0!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d607a56d5a9:0x3ab5ddc92ba47796!2m2!1d14.498766!2d46.052969!3e2) or [Kolizej](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Kolizej,+Slovenija/Moderna+galerija+Ljubljana+-+knji%C5%BEnica,+Slovenija/@46.0539615,14.4984935,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765329fb4161a0f:0xf055591233193ebe!2m2!1d14.502506!2d46.055623!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d607a56d5a9:0x3ab5ddc92ba47796!2m2!1d14.498766!2d46.052969!3e2) stops.

Routes 14, 14B, 18 – get off at the [Cankarjev Dom](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Cankarjev+dom,+Slovenija/Moderna+galerija+Ljubljana+-+knji%C5%BEnica,+Slovenija/@46.0520377,14.496615,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d6096112de9:0xa385ef7abef58a0d!2m2!1d14.498397!2d46.051099!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d607a56d5a9:0x3ab5ddc92ba47796!2m2!1d14.498766!2d46.052969!3e2) stop.

Routes 05, 13, 20 – get off at the [Dalmatinova](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Dalmatinova,+Slovenija/Moderna+galerija+Ljubljana+-+knji%C5%BEnica,+Slovenija/@46.0534522,14.4998408,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765329e07427813:0x2e8cbf1d3f0402fb!2m2!1d14.505317!2d46.054193!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d607a56d5a9:0x3ab5ddc92ba47796!2m2!1d14.498766!2d46.052969!3e2) stop.

**By train** | The [Ljubljana railway station](http://www.slo-zeleznice.si/en/passengers/slovenia) is approximately a [twenty-minute walk](http://www.google.com/maps/dir/%C5%BDelezni%C5%A1ka+postaja+Ljubljana,+Ljubljana,+Slovenija/Moderna+galerija+Ljubljana+-+knji%C5%BEnica,+Slovenija/@46.0555003,14.5012018,16z/data=!4m17!4m16!1m8!2m2!1d14.5126836!2d46.0587303!3m4!1m2!1d14.5070227!2d46.0539538!3s0x4765329d8d6f2643:0x8945382cb7a33d08!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d607a56d5a9:0x3ab5ddc92ba47796!2m2!1d14.498766!2d46.052969!3e2) from Moderna galerija. Alternatively, you can take a [bus](http://www.google.com/maps/dir/%C5%BDelezni%C5%A1ka+postaja+Ljubljana,+Ljubljana,+Slovenija/Moderna+galerija+Ljubljana+-+knji%C5%BEnica,+Slovenija/@46.0568555,14.4950854,15z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m12!4m11!1m3!2m2!1d14.5126836!2d46.0587303!1m5!1m1!1s0x47652d607a56d5a9:0x3ab5ddc92ba47796!2m2!1d14.498766!2d46.052969!3e3).

**By car** | In the streets around Moderna galerija (MG+) there are short-term parking areas (with automated payment machines). There are also parking lots and parking garages in the vicinity ([Parking Facilities](http://www.lpt.si/en/parkings)).

**ACCESS**

All the floors of the museum are accessible by elevator and stairs. Contact**:** +386 1 2416 800, +386 1 2416 834, [info@mg-lj.si](mailto:info@mg-lj.si?subject=Obisk%20Moderne%20galerije).

Main entrance at Cankarjeva 15:

![](/media/774fdf0053/_EES4633-750x260.jpg)
